朝鮮總督府統計年報 1919

Chōsen Sōtokufu tōkei nenpō (Statistical Annual of the Government-General of Korea), 大正八年 (Taishō 8), published 1920
朝鮮總督府, 京城, 1920 (大正九年)

All 472 numbered tables and a few unnumbered sub-tables are transcribed (476 tables, about 170,000 figure cells), with the contents; the 凡例, the contents pages and the colophon are not. Tables printed across both pages of a spread are joined into one; a few very long tables were read in sections by different readers and joined. Each spread was read once by a Claude Sonnet agent from tight crops, with no second reading. 342 cells could not be read and are marked [?]; 2 that a printed total fixes exactly are filled in and shown with a blue background (inferred). Printed totals were re-added; many that do not add up (often by a round 10, 100 or 1,000, which points to misprints in the original) are kept as printed and noted, and where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted. Table 39 prints its number as 37; it is numbered 39 here as in the contents.
